name: Making Things
about: Nina and Bruno's shared power (Hayden, 12 Nov 2026: 'nina and bruno share an ability to create, but its weaker for that reason'). Nina says Bruno found out something; Bruno and Nina show the hero they can make things together, and share it with the hero too (scripts/make.gd). Offered by Nina in the Void once The Bike Boy's done.

steps.text: Nina says Bruno found out something amazing, and he won't stop showing off about it. Find Bruno (he's usually at the Skate Park).
Nina and Bruno shared their making power with you! Press Make (Z, or RB on a controller) to make a little bridge in front of you, or a step under your feet in the air. Make three things.
You made three things! Go and show Nina.

reward.message: Nina and Bruno's making power is yours to share! Press Make any time. (+8 sparkles)
